title: Sketches of the Natural History of Ceylon
sourceTitle: Sketches of the Natural History of Ceylon
author: Tennent, James Emerson, Sir
description: "Sketches of the Natural History of Ceylon" by Sir James Emerson Tennent is a scientific publication written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This work delves into the rich and diverse fauna of Ceylon (modern-day Sri Lanka), exploring various species of mammals, birds, reptiles, and insects, while providing narratives and anecdotes that illustrate their behaviors and instincts.

authorInfo.bio: Tennent, James Emerson, Sir (1804–1869) wrote Sketches of the Natural History of Ceylon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
